title: Built a gold EA, backtest looked good, now it’s live and I’m paranoid.
author: Turbulent_Carry3906

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: being paranoid on a small account is the healthy version of this. the first thing I'd watch is gold's spread around CPI and NFP. most MT5 backtests run a fixed spread, live gold widens a lot in those minutes, and if the live fills on those days look worse than the test, that's your gap, not the logic.

replies.author: Turbulent_Carry3906
replies.body: Ohhh, thats a fantastic idea i can modify my downloaded ticks and use AI for modify the spreads and do them huge in comparison with the original spread. Thank you for that. Is a big help. I will share the results

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: careful letting AI make the spreads up though. I'd pull the real spread from those news minutes out of your broker's tick history and apply that, or just multiply by a fixed factor, so the test stays something you can rerun and compare.

replies.author: Turbulent_Carry3906
replies.body: The ticks i used was from two different brokers two live account ticks vantage 2026 until today and full 2025 with roboforex which has higher spread. Its the only tick data i have downloaded.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: that mix is handy. if the 2025 RoboForex year still holds up with its wider spread, that's a better sign than a clean run on the Vantage ticks. if only the Vantage year works, the edge was the spread.

replies.author: Alphanet_dogwalker
replies.body: The broker and the year both change there so you cant pin a difference on spread alone. You can rerun each dataset with its original spread and then a wider one, keeping the price path and settings fixed. That gives you a cleaner view of how sensitive it is to costs

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: 15 live trades is noise, but the spread gap is the real tell. If your edge only shows up on Vantage ticks and dies on the wider RoboForex year, you don't have an edge, you have a spread assumption. Rerun both datasets with the same settings before you trust it.
